def equation(t, x, v, params):

    C = np.cos(w*t); S = np.sin(w*t)
    C2 = np.cos(2*w*t); S2 = np.sin(2*w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*v + params[3]*C + params[4]*S
